summary: Legacy candidate: add a repo-local context pointer file (.ai/context.yaml) to the App1 product repo when engineering starts and collaborators grow.
detail: Originally kept as candidate (value limited while repo is docs-only, single writer). V1.1 repo-local context policy (Spec §3.3, R6) supersedes the mechanism: repo-local context files are generated directly from main reality at engineering start and upgraded to schema 1.1; the shared-memory pointer content moves into the V1.1 .ai/context.yaml shape.
disposition_note: Covered by V1.1 repo-local context policy (Spec §3.3 + R6). Revisit adding App1 .ai/context.yaml when product engineering starts (T21+).
